**Pacific Pacific Education Sdn. Bhd. – Company Snapshot (SYN‑000397)** | Item | Details | |------|---------| | **Incorporation** | 11 May 2006 (Private limited company) | | **Status** | Active | | **Industry / Business** | Education – operates tuition centres for primary and secondary students in Selangor | | **Share Capital** | RM 2.5 million | | **Directors (as of 2023‑10‑06)** | • Director 1 – Managing Director (appointed 13 Nov 2017)
• Director 2 – Director (appointed 29 May 2017)
• Director 3 – Director (appointed 10 Sep 2013)
• Director 4 – Executive Director (appointed 6 Oct 2023) | | **Shareholder Structure** | • Director 1 – 49.67 % (individual)
• Director 4 – 33.46 %
• Director 2 – 14.89 %
• Director 3 – 1.98 % | | **Key Financials** | **FY 2022** (ended 31 Dec 2022) – Revenue RM 6.45 m, Profit after tax RM 0.42 m (net margin 6.5 %). Quick ratio 1.96, debt‑to‑equity 1.44.
**FY 2024** (ended 31 Dec 2024) – Revenue RM 6.86 m (+6 % YoY), Profit after tax RM 0.37 m (net margin 5.4 %). Quick ratio 2.55, debt‑to‑equity 0.95.
Operating cash flow remains healthy (RM 0.94 m in 2022, RM 0.57 m in 2024) and free cash flow turned positive in 2024 (RM 0.19 m). | | **Profitability Trends** | Gross margin stable around 48 %; operating margin slipped from 9.8 % (2022) to 8.3 % (2024). EBITDA fell modestly (RM 1.00 m → RM 0.97 m). | | **Liquidity & Solvency** | Quick ratio improved from 1.96 to 2.55; cash‑to‑revenue rose from 7.7 % to 9.2 %. Leverage fell from 1.44× to 0.95×, and interest‑coverage stayed strong (>6×). | | **Operational Efficiency** | Days sales outstanding ≈ 100 days; cash conversion cycle increased from ~39 days (2022) to ~47 days (2024) due to slightly longer receivable periods and faster payables. | | **Litigation (latest)** | • **CASE‑2025‑5402** – Debt‑recovery, High Court (Selangor), settled, claim RM 7.43 m.
• **CASE‑2025‑7729** – Tenancy dispute, Sessions Court, pending, claim RM 0.32 m.
• **CASE‑2023‑7966** – Breach of contract, Sessions Court, pending, claim RM 0.46 m.
• Other cases (2019‑2022) include construction and tenancy disputes, mixed outcomes (judgment entered, dismissed). | | **Overall Assessment** | Pacific Pacific Education is a modest‑size, privately‑held tuition‑centre operator with steady revenue growth and solid cash generation. Profitability has modestly compressed, but liquidity and leverage have improved, reducing financial risk. Ongoing legal matters are largely related to tenancy and contract disputes, with one large debt‑recovery case already settled. The ownership is tightly held by the four directors, with Director 1 remaining the controlling shareholder. |
